sn22.79:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussaramānā anussaranti || sabbe te pañcupādānakkhandhe anussaranti etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ || ||
sn22.79:1.5: iti vā hi bhikkhave anussaramāno rūpaññeva anussarati || ||
sn22.79:1.7: iti vā bhikkhave anussaramāno vedanaññeva anussarati || ||
sn22.79:1.11: iti vā hi bhikkhave anussaramāno viññāṇam eva anussarati || || 5
sn22.79:2.2: Ruppatīti kho bhikkhave tasmā rūpan ti vuccati || ||
sn22.79:2.4: sītena pi ruppati uṇhena pi ruppati jighacchāya pi ruppati pipāsāya pi ruppati ḍaṃsa-makasa-vātātapa-siriṃsapa-samphassena pi ruppati ||
sn22.79:2.5: ruppatīti kho bhikkhave tasmā rūpan ti vuccāti || || 6
sn22.79:3.2: Vediyantīti kho bhikkhave tasmā vedanā ti vuccati || ||
sn22.79:3.4: sukham pi vediyati dukkham pi vediyati adukkhamasukham pi vediyati ||
sn22.79:3.5: vediyatīti kho bhikkhave tasmā vedanā ti vuccati || || 7
sn22.79:4.2: Sañjānātīti kho bhikkhave tasmā saññā ti vuccati ||
sn22.79:4.4: nīlam pi sañjānāti pītakam pi sañjānāti lohitakam pi sañjānāti odātam pi sañjānāti ||
sn22.79:4.5: sañjānātīti kho bhikkhave tasmā saññā ti vuccati || || 8
sn22.79:5.2: Saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharontīti bhikkhave tasmā saṅkhārā ti vuccanti || ||
sn22.79:5.4: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam abhisaṅkharonti vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam abhisaṅkharonti || saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam abhisaṅkharonti || saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam abhisaṅkharonti || viññāṇaṃ viññāṇatthāya saṅkhatam abhisaṅkharonti ||
sn22.79:5.5: saṅkhatam abhisaṅkharontīti kho bhikkhave tasmā saṅkhārā ti vuccanti || || 9
sn22.79:6.2: vijānātīti kho bhikkhave tasmā viññāṇan ti vuccati || ||
sn22.79:6.4: ambilam pi vijānāti || tittakam pi vijānāti || kaṭukam pi vijānāti madhukam pi vijānāti || khārikam pi vijānāti || akhārikam pi vijānāti || loṇakam pi vijānāti || aloṇakam pi vijānāti ||
sn22.79:6.5: vijānātīti kho bhikkhave tasmā viññāṇan ti vuccati || || 10
sn22.79:7.1: Tatra bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati || || 11
sn22.79:7.3: atītam paham addhānam evam eva rūpena khajjiṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi ||
sn22.79:7.4: ahaṃ ceva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ anāgatam paham addhānaṃ evam eva rūpena khajjeyyaṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmīti || ||
sn22.79:7.5: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekho hoti ||
sn22.79:7.7: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || || 12
sn22.79:8.2: atītaṃ paham addhānam evam eva vedanāya khajjim seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannāya vedanāya khajjāmi ||
sn22.79:8.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana anāgataṃ vedanam abhinandeyyaṃ
sn22.79:8.4: anāgatam pahaṃ addhānam evam eva vedanāya khajjeyyaṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannāya vedanāya khajjāmīti || ||
sn22.79:8.5: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītāya vedanāya anapekho hoti ||
sn22.79:8.7: paccuppannāya vedanāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || || 13
sn22.79:9.3: atītaṃ paham addhānam evam eva saṅkhārehi khajjiṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmi || ahaṃ
sn22.79:9.4: ceva kho pana anāgate saṅkhāre abhinandeyyaṃ
sn22.79:9.5: anagatam paham addhānam evam eva saṅkhārehi khajjeyyaṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmīti || ||
sn22.79:9.6: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītesu saṅkhāresu anapekho hoti ||
sn22.79:9.8: paccuppannānaṃ saṅkhārānam nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || || 15
sn22.79:10.2: atītam pi addhānam evam eva viññāṇena khajjiṃ seyyathāpī etarahi paccuppannena viññāṇena khajjāmi ||
sn22.79:10.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana anāgatam viññāṇam abhinandeyyam
sn22.79:10.4: anāgatam paham addhānam evam eva viññāṇena khajjeyyaṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena viññāṇena khajjāmīti || ||
sn22.79:10.5: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekho hoti ||
sn22.79:10.7: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || || 16
sn22.79:11.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccam vā ti || ||
sn22.79:11.4: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti || ||
sn22.79:11.6: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkham vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassitum
sn22.79:11.7: Etaṃ mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn22.79:11.12: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti ||
sn22.79:11.14: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ va taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.79:11.16: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassituṃ
sn22.79:11.17: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn22.79:11.19: Tasmātiha bhikkhave yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ Netaṃ mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti || evaṃ etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbam || || 22
sn22.79:11.23: Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccupannaṃ || la || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 26
sn22.79:12.1: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako apacināti no ācināti ||
sn22.79:13.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi || saññāya pi || saṅkhāresu pi || viññānasmim pi nibbindati || ||
sn22.79:13.2: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñaṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn22.79:13.3: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || 32
sn22.79:14.1: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu nevācināti na apacināti || apacinitvā ṭhito neva pajahati na upādiyati || pajahitvā ṭhito neva viseneti na usseneti || visenetvā ṭhito neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti || || 33 Vidhūpetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.2: kiñca nevācināti na apacināti || apacinitvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.3: rūpam nevācināti na apacināti || apacinitvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.7: viññāṇaṃ nevācināti na apacināti || || 34 Apacinitvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.8: kiñca neva pajahati na upādiyati || pajahitvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.9: rūpaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati || pajahitvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.13: viññāṇaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati || || 35 Pajahitvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.14: kiñca neva viseneti na usseneti || visenetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.15: rūpaṃ neva vineseti na usseneti || visenetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.19: viññāṇaṃ neva viseneti na usseneti || || 36 Visenetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.20: kiñca neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti || vidhūpetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.21: rūpaṃ neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti || vidhūpetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.25: viññāṇaṃ neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti || || 37 Vidhūpetvā ṭhito
sn22.79:14.26: evaṃ vimuttacittaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ sa-indakādevā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakā va namassanti || || 38
